name: @usdk/driver-llm-fixture
description: A deterministic, offline capability-llm driver, for every test and demo in this workspace that needs reproducible output - the JS analogue of src/driver_fixture/driver_fixture.c. Every response is prefixed with a literal '[fixture]' marker so it can never be mistaken for real model inference, per this task's explicit instruction. There is no other LLM driver wired up in this release - see @usdk/driver-llm-local and docs/IMPLEMENTATION_STATUS.md.
